basic_details.job_title: RGU Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for Registrar, Finance Officer and More Posts
basic_details.post_name: Registrar, Finance Officer and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Rajiv Gandhi University (RGU) Registrar, Finance Officer and More Posts Notification 2026 has been released on the official website of Rajiv Gandhi University (RGU). A total of 5 vacancies have been announced through the RGU Registrar, Finance Officer and More Posts Recruitment 2026.

age_limit.details: Maximum Age Limit: 57 years for all posts.

qualification.education_qualification: Master's Degree with at least 55% marks or equivalent grade 'B' in UGC seven point scale, 15 years experience as Assistant Professor or administrative experience
qualification.details: Registrar, Finance Officer, Controller of Examinations: Master's Degree with at least 55% of the marks or its equivalent grade of 'B' in the UGC seven point scale. At least 15 years of experience as Assistant Professor in the AGP of Rs. 7000 and above or with 08 years' of service in the AGP of Rs. 8000 and above including as Associate professor, along with experience in educational administration OR Comparable experience in a research establishment and/or other institutions of higher education OR 15 years of administrative experience, of which 08 years shall be as Deputy Registrar or an equivalent post.

how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the RGU Various Posts Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 02-08-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of RGU to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the RGU Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. Download RGU Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: RGU Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Registrar, Finance Officer, Controller of Examinations: Master's Degree with at least 55% of the marks or its equivalent grade of 'B' in the UGC seven point scale. At least 15 years of experience as Assistant Professor in the AGP of Rs. 7000 and above or with 08 years' of service in the AGP of Rs. 8000 and above including as Associate professor, along with experience in educational administration OR Comparable experience in a research establishment and/or other institutions of higher education OR 15 years of administrative experience, of which 08 years shall be as Deputy Registrar or an equivalent post.

content_sections.heading: RGU Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 57 years for all posts.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the RGU Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 02-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of RGU to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the RGU Statutory Officers posts?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of online applications is 02 August 2026. Ensure your application is submitted before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Master's Degree with at least 55% marks or equivalent grade 'B' in the UGC seven point scale, along with 15 years of relevant experience.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all Statutory Officer posts is 57 years.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for Statutory Officers?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies announced for the Statutory Officers positions.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for General category candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General and OBC category candidates is Rs. 1000.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for SC/ST candidates?
faq.answer: Yes, SC/ST candidates are required to pay an application fee of Rs. 500.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary structure for these positions?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will be placed at Level 14 as per the 7th Central Pay Commission (CPC).

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for RGU recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted through the online mode only.

faq.question: Q9. What are the selection methods for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an Interview and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for RGU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the Important Links section provided in this article.
